correctness.rationale: Exact orthogonal QR coordinate block [[I,b],[0,0]] follows from independent Gaussian sketches; top singular value sqrt(1+||b||^2) is almost surely unique, and symmetrized rank-one SVD has minimum eigenvalue (1-sqrt(1+||b||^2))/2. Wishart-integrated regression b=g/sqrt(V), V chi-squared with ell+1 df, produces the Beta law and explicit CDF, tail, and moment iff condition. The executable verifier passed 812 checks; finite checks do not replace the analytic derivation.
